answer.text: IPS/policy statement → study current financial conditions and future trends → portfolio construction → monitoring and rebalancing → performance measurement and evaluation

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes the portfolio management process as starting with the policy statement, studying current financial conditions and future trends, constructing the portfolio, continuously monitoring and rebalancing it, and finally measuring and evaluating performance. The Trap: Stock-picking-first or execution-first sequences invert the top-down flow. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.163, p.174-175.
